description: This file contains multiple functions that set up mock server expectations for request matching based on various request properties such as path, method, headers, query parameters, cookies, body content (XML, JSON, XPath, regex), and response configurations. It is part of mockserver examples demonstrating request property matchers.

methods.name: matchRequestByPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests with a specific path.

methods.name: matchRequestByPathExactlyTwice
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for a specific path to be matched exactly twice.

methods.name: matchRequestByPathExactlyOnceInTheNext60Seconds
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for a specific path to be matched once within 60 seconds.

methods.name: matchRequestByRegexPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests with a path matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests with a path not matching a specific pattern.

methods.name: matchRequestByMethodRegex
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests with a method matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingMethod
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests with a method not matching a specific value.

methods.name: matchRequestByPathAndPathParametersAndQueryParametersName
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation matching path with path parameters and query parameters.

methods.name: matchRequestByPathParameterRegexValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with path parameters matching regex patterns.

methods.name: matchRequestByPathParameterJsonSchemaValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with path parameters validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByQueryParameterRegexName
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with query parameters matching regex names.

methods.name: matchRequestByQueryParameterRegexValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with query parameter values matching regex patterns.

methods.name: matchRequestByOptionalQueryParameterRegexValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with optional query parameters matching regex patterns.

methods.name: matchRequestByQueryParameterJsonSchemaValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with query parameters validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByQueryParameterSubSet
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with a subset of query parameters.

methods.name: matchRequestByQueryParameterKeyMatching
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with query parameter keys matching a specific style.

methods.name: matchRequestByHeaders
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation matching request headers.

methods.name: matchRequestByHeaderNameRegex
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with header names matching regex.

methods.name: matchRequestByHeaderRegexNameAndValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with headers matching regex for name and value.

methods.name: matchRequestByHeaderJsonSchemaValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with headers validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByEitherOrOptionalHeader
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with optional or alternative headers.

methods.name: matchRequestByHeaderKeyMatching
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with header keys matching a specific style.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingHeaderValue
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for headers not matching specific values.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingHeaders
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for requests missing specific headers.

methods.name: matchRequestByCookiesAndQueryParameters
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation matching cookies and query parameters.

methods.name: matchRequestByCookiesAndQueryParameterJsonSchemaValues
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with cookies and query parameters validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByOptionalCookiesAndQueryParameterJsonSchemaValues
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation with optional cookies and query parameters validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByRegexBody
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for request bodies matching a regex pattern.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyInUTF16
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for request bodies in UTF-16 encoding.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithFormSubmission
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for form submission bodies.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithXPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for XML bodies matching an XPath expression.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingBodyWithXPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for XML bodies not matching an XPath expression.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithXml
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for XML bodies.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithXmlWithPlaceholders
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for XML bodies with placeholders.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithXmlSchema
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for XML bodies validated against an XML schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonExactly
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies matching exactly.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonIgnoringExtraFields
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies ignoring extra fields.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonIgnoringExtraFieldsInArrayObjects
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies ignoring extra fields in array objects.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonWithPlaceholders
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies with placeholders.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonSchema
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies validated against JSON schema.

methods.name: matchRequestByBodyWithJsonPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies matching a JSONPath.

methods.name: matchRequestByNotMatchingBodyWithJsonPath
methods.description: Sets up a mock expectation for JSON bodies not matching a JSONPath.
